payload: Using the configured PyLabRobot deck, generate a protocol that transfers 50 µL from each well of a 96-well source plate to the corresponding well of a 96-well destination plate. The source plate is at deck location 1 and the destination plate is at deck location 2. Use a single-channel pipette with a 200 µL tip. The protocol must be written in Python and must not include any physical hardware execution.
